denial.reason_text: Conservative therapy requirement not met. The records do not document at least 6 weeks of physical therapy or a supervised home exercise program.

requirements.text: Symptoms present for at least 6 weeks
requirements.policy_text: Symptoms have been present for at least 6 weeks.

evidence.quote: Symptoms have now been present for about 8 weeks, with onset on 08/10/2026.
evidence.rationale: Physician states the duration and onset date at the 10/06/2026 visit.

evidence.quote: Low back pain began about 08/10/2026 after he lifted a pallet at work.
evidence.rationale: Onset date recorded at the first visit, consistent with the later note.

quantity_check.label: Symptom duration at the request date

requirements.text: At least 6 weeks of physical therapy or a supervised home exercise program in the 3 months before the request
requirements.policy_text: The member completed at least 6 weeks of physical therapy or a supervised home exercise program within the 3 months before the request.

evidence.quote: The patient attended 8 of 12 planned visits between 09/01/2026 and 09/29/2026, a period of 4 weeks.
evidence.rationale: Documents physical therapy, but for 4 weeks. The policy requires 6.

near_misses.quote: Physical therapy 2 visits per week for 6 weeks (12 visits).
near_misses.why_not: This is the planned course. The discharge note shows it was not completed.

near_misses.quote: Home exercise program handout issued (prone press-ups and nerve glides), to be done daily.
near_misses.why_not: A handout was issued. The policy requires a supervised program with documented follow-up.

near_misses.quote: He says he has done his home exercises most days since leaving physical therapy.
near_misses.why_not: Patient-reported and unsupervised, with no log. It also covers only the week after therapy ended.

gap.summary: 4 of 6 weeks of physical therapy documented (09/01/2026 to 09/29/2026).
gap.what_would_satisfy: Documentation of 2 more weeks of physical therapy, or of a supervised home exercise program with a signed log, within the 3 months before the request (policy §3.1(b)).
gap.suggested_action: Ask Stride Physical Therapy whether any supervised sessions or a signed exercise log exist after 09/29/2026. If none exist, the member needs 2 more weeks before the request is resubmitted. Do not count unsupervised home exercise.

requirements.text: Anti-inflammatory or analgesic medication trial of at least 4 weeks
requirements.policy_text: The member completed a trial of an anti-inflammatory or analgesic medication for at least 4 weeks, unless contraindicated.

evidence.quote: He has taken naproxen 500 mg twice daily for six weeks with minimal relief.
evidence.rationale: Physician documents a six-week naproxen trial and its result.

evidence.quote: Start naproxen 500 mg twice daily with food.

requirements.text: Clinical re-evaluation after conservative therapy documents persistent symptoms
requirements.policy_text: A clinical re-evaluation after conservative therapy documents persistent symptoms.

evidence.quote: Re-evaluation after conservative therapy: right-sided low back and leg pain persists at 6 out of 10 with no meaningful improvement.

key_phrases.text: persists at 6 out of 10 with no meaningful improvement

evidence.rationale: Dated physician re-evaluation stating that symptoms persist.

requirements.text: Record documents a red-flag finding: progressive motor weakness, bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, or suspected cancer, infection or fracture
requirements.policy_text: 3.2 Red-flag exception. Criteria 3.1(a) through 3.1(d) do not apply when the record documents any of the following: progressive motor weakness; bowel or bladder dysfunction or saddle anesthesia; or suspected cancer, infection, or fracture.

near_misses.quote: Strength is 5/5 in both legs. No saddle anesthesia. He denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, fever, and unexplained weight loss, and has no history of cancer.
near_misses.why_not: The 10/06/2026 examination documents normal strength and the absence of each red-flag finding.

near_misses.quote: He denies bowel or bladder changes, saddle numbness, fever, and weight loss.
near_misses.why_not: The 08/24/2026 visit also records that he denies red-flag symptoms.

near_misses.quote: No fracture or destructive bone lesion.
near_misses.why_not: The X-ray shows no fracture and no destructive lesion.

gap.summary: The record documents that red-flag findings are absent.
gap.what_would_satisfy: A documented red-flag finding under policy §3.2.
gap.suggested_action: Do not appeal on this basis.

recommendation.banner: Evidence incomplete for §3.1(b): 4 of 6 weeks of physical therapy documented. No alternative basis is supported by this record. Obtain documentation for the remaining 2 weeks before appealing.
recommendation.rationale: Three of four requirements are supported. §3.1(b) is 2 weeks short, and the §3.2 exception does not apply because the record documents the absence of red-flag findings.
human_actions: Ask the physical therapy clinic for any records after 09/29/2026.
If none exist, plan 2 more weeks of supervised therapy and resubmit.
Do not submit an appeal that states the 6-week requirement was met.

blocks.text: Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination, reference C-4420. MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
The member has had right-sided low back and leg pain for about 8 weeks, with onset on 08/10/2026.
He took naproxen 500 mg twice daily for six weeks with minimal relief.
A re-evaluation after conservative therapy documented persistent pain at 6 out of 10 with no meaningful improvement.
Physical therapy: 4 of the required 6 weeks are documented (09/01/2026 to 09/29/2026). This paragraph cannot be written until the remaining 2 weeks are documented.
